plans.text: Build a broad understanding of Python first, then explore data science and machine learning
Track coding progress by logging completed challenges, learned concepts, and improved skills
Set specific goals, such as completing a certain number of challenges within a timeframe or mastering a particular skill
Complete personal projects such as a simple web scraper or a chatbot
Collaborate with other developers on coding challenges

preferences.text: Looking for resources with a wide range of coding challenges and exercises, especially for Python, that also help with problem-solving
Finds that seeing progress and achieving small victories helps stay motivated
Reminds themself why they started learning to code in order to improve their skills and open up new opportunities
